related_entry.title: Left-Cone Reconstruction Lemmas and Complete Classification of Jen's Left-Permutive Class in Rule30Realization
related_entry.abstract:
For the general left-permutive cellular automaton family `run (g : Bool -> Bool -> Bool)` in `Ruliology.CellularAutomata.Rule30Realization`, Jen's adjacent-column theorem `run_not_adjacent` assumes `g false false = false` and `g false true = true`. We prove that a Boolean function `g` satisfies these two hypotheses if and only if `g = g90 \lor g = g150 \lor g = g210 \lor g = g30` (`Rule30Submission.jen_class_iff_four_rules`). Within this four-element class, we prove three exact equivalences for the single-seed evolution `run g`: (1) `\forall t\,p,\, run g t p = run g90 t p` holds if and only if `g = g90 \lor g = g210` (`Rule30Submission.run_eq_run90_iff_g90_or_g210`); (2) the single-seed pattern is mirror-symmetric (`\forall t\,p,\, run g t (-p) = run g t p`) if and only if `g = g90 \lor g = g150 \lor g = g210` (`Rule30Submission.run_symm_iff_not_g30`); and (3) the center column `fun t => run g t 0` is not eventually constant (`\lnot \exists T\,b,\, \forall t \ge T,\, run g t 0 = b`) if and only if `g = g30` (`Rule30Submission.g30_unique_nonconstant_in_jen_class`).

In addition, we prove explicit multi-step left-cone reconstruction lemmas extending `Rule30Jen.cell_left` and `Rule30Realization.lc`: a closed-form two-step formula for `cell t (p - 2)` (`Rule30Submission.tlf_cell_two_step_left_retrodiction`), all-depth left-cone uniqueness by strong induction on `k : \mathbb{N}` for any two trajectories obeying `rule` that agree on two adjacent columns (`Rule30Submission.tlf_left_cone_unique_all_depths`), and exact agreement of the recursive left-reconstruction operator `lc seed center m t` with `cell t (-m)` (`Rule30Submission.lc_seed_eq_cell`, `Rule30Submission.lc_seed_triangle_and_diag`).

Nothing is claimed for eventual periods $P \ge 2$ of `Rule30Prize.center`.
